description: Continuous budgeting under genuine constraint measurably reduces the cognitive capacity available for anything else. The effect is a consequence of the condition, not a trait of the person in it.
energy_note: A calculator running in your head, all day, for years.

aspect: And the load is invisible to everyone else
description: The household appears to function. What it costs to make it function is not observable, which is why the person doing it is described as coping.
energy_note: Praised for coping, which is the description of the injury.

aspect: Decision fatigue produces the expensive mistakes
description: After enough small decisions the large ones are made badly, which is when the bad loan is taken and the wrong school fee is deferred.
energy_note: Worst judgement, exactly where it matters most.

aspect: It transmits to the children as a temperament
description: Children raised in continuous financial vigilance acquire it. The capable, anxious, over-responsible adult is a predictable output and is usually described as a personality.
energy_note: Competent at nine, exhausted at forty.

description: Tomatoes are up again. She recalculates the week in her head at the stall: swap the fish for eggs, defer the kerosene, the school levy is Thursday, her sister owes her NGN 4,000 and will not have it. She does this four or five times a day and has done for eleven years.
energy_note: Five recalculations a day, for eleven years.
